dialogue.content: こんばんは、時間になったらはじめさせてもらいます。本日はよろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. We'll get started at the scheduled time. I look forward to speaking with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします🤲
dialogue.English: I look forward to it, too. 🤲

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談ありがとうございます。まずは年齢と性別、相談内容を教えてください
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out today. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 26歳　女性　体調が悪く何もやる気がでません
dialogue.English: I'm a 26-year-old woman. I'm not feeling well and have no motivation to do anything.

dialogue.content: 体調が悪いのですね・・・それはお辛いですよねその体調が悪いというのをもう少し詳しくお聞きしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I see you're not feeling well... That must be difficult. Could you tell me a little more about what you mean by "not feeling well"?

dialogue.content: 喉が痛くうまく声がでないのです
dialogue.English: My throat is sore and I can't speak properly.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・いつからですか？
dialogue.English: I see... When did it start?

dialogue.content: 1週間前からです
dialogue.English: It started a week ago.

dialogue.content: 何か原因となるような事に心当たりありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea what might have caused it?

dialogue.content: うーん最近の寒暖差ですね
dialogue.English: Hmm, probably the recent temperature swings.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねやる気が出ないくらい喉の調子が悪いのであれば医療機関などいかれましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. If your throat is so bad that you have no motivation, have you seen a doctor?

dialogue.content: 行きました！
dialogue.English: Yes, I have!

dialogue.content: お医者様はなんと言っていましたか？
dialogue.English: What did the doctor say?

dialogue.content: 喉の風邪だと(emoji)
dialogue.English: That it's a throat cold. (emoji)

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！教えて下さってありがとうございます。でも
dialogue.English: I see! Thank you for telling me. But...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: やる気がでないとおっしゃっていましたが、のどの調子が治ったらやる気はでますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you have no motivation. Do you think you'll get your motivation back once your throat feels better?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: なにか他に何か気になる事がありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else that's bothering you?

dialogue.content: おやすみがほしいですね
dialogue.English: I need some rest.

dialogue.content: えっ・・おやすみされていないのですか？
dialogue.English: Oh... you haven't been getting any days off?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: もしよければ、お仕事の内容や、お休みがとれない理由など話せる範囲でお聞かせいただいていいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you tell me a bit about your work and why you can't take time off, to the extent that you're willing to share?

dialogue.content: キャバクラではたらいててやすめません
dialogue.English: I work at a hostess club, and I can't take time off.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・なぜ休めないのかもう少し詳しく聞かせてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I see... Could you tell me a little more about why you can't take time off?

dialogue.content: 有給がないのでお金を稼がないといけないので
dialogue.English: I don't have paid leave, so I have to keep earning money.

dialogue.content: 聞かせてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: お金を稼ぐために一生懸命、きつくても休まずに働いておられるのですね
dialogue.English: So you're working very hard to earn money, without taking a break even when it's tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもそのままではあなたはいつか体調を壊してしまうのではないかと心配になってしまいますが
dialogue.English: But I'm worried that if you continue like this, you might end up seriously harming your health.

dialogue.content: 今の状況をあなた自身どのように思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you yourself feel about your current situation?

dialogue.content: 状況はこのままじゃいけないとおもいます
dialogue.English: I don't think I can go on like this.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね現実的にどのようになればいいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Realistically, what would you like to see happen?

dialogue.content: おやすみをしっかりとって復帰できればとおもいます
dialogue.English: I'd like to take some proper time off and then return to work.

dialogue.content: それはすごくいい事だと思います。でも実際それが現実的にできないということですか？
dialogue.English: I think that's a very good idea. But are you saying that it's not realistically possible right now?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。色々お話を聞かせてくれてありがとうございます。少しここでお話を整理させてもらってもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing so much with me. May I take a moment to summarize our conversation so far?

dialogue.content: あなたは喉の痛みでやる気がでないとのことでした。お医者様からはのど風邪と診断されましたが実際はおやすみがとれない状況とのことでしたね
dialogue.English: You said you have no motivation because of a sore throat. The doctor diagnosed it as a throat cold, but the real issue seems to be that you're unable to take any time off.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 実際はおやすみをしっかりとって復帰したいとのことでしたが、これまで整理した中でなにか他にできそうなことはありませんか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you'd like to take a proper rest and then return to work. Based on what we've discussed, is there anything else you think you could do?

dialogue.content: リフレッシュしに行きたいですね
dialogue.English: I'd like to go somewhere to refresh myself.

dialogue.content: それはいいですね！
dialogue.English: That sounds great!

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 相談員はあなたが体調が悪いのにも関わらず一生懸命働いているのを想像すると辛いだろうなと思いますでも
dialogue.English: As your counselor, it pains me to imagine you working so hard despite not feeling well, but...

dialogue.content: 1日でもいいのでリフレッシュする時間をとることによって、少しは仕事に対するやる気なども変わってくるのではないかと思いました
dialogue.English: I was thinking that by taking even just one day to refresh yourself, your motivation for work might change a little.

dialogue.content: あなたはどう思われますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そう思います
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: リフレッシュできる時間はとれそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you'll be able to take some time to refresh yourself?

dialogue.content: お返事がないようですが・・・大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: I haven't heard back from you... Are you alright?

dialogue.content: あなたがこれから少しでも楽にお仕事ができるように、休息の時間を大事にしてほしい、ご自分の体をもっと大事にしてほしいと心から願うばかりです
dialogue.English: I sincerely hope that you'll value your time for rest and take better care of your body so that work can be a little easier for you from now on.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です！すみませんありがとございます
dialogue.English: I'm okay! Sorry, and thank you.

dialogue.content: とれそうです！
dialogue.English: I think I can take some time off!

dialogue.content: それはよかったです。お時間バタバタのなってしまい申し訳ありません。そろそろ終了の時間となってしまいましたが、また何かお辛くなった時は何回でも相談来てください。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I'm sorry that we had to rush at the end. It's almost time for our session to end, but if things get difficult again, please feel free to come back as many times as you need.

dialogue.content: ありがとございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。失礼します
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Take care.

dialogue.content: （すみません、Wi-Fiの調子ですかね？？最後変になってしまいましたが、これで終了させていただきます。勉強になりました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Sorry, I think it might have been the Wi-Fi? Things got a little strange at the end, but we'll end here. This was a great learning experience. Thank you very much.)
